# Burch Contracting — Screened Porch Builder

> Upstate SC's dedicated screened porch specialists: custom builds, patio enclosures, and repairs serving Simpsonville, Fountain Inn, Gray Court, and Laurens, SC. SC Licensed General Contractor #CLG118679, established 1995.

## Services

- [Custom Screened Porch Build](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#services): Full design and construction of screened porches from scratch — on a new pad, an existing deck, or tied into your home's roofline. Includes full permit handling (Greenville & Laurens County), roof style options (gable, shed, hip, cathedral), structural aluminum or pressure-treated wood framing, and optional ceiling fans, lighting, and TV rough-in. Most builds complete in 3–7 business days after permit approval.

- [Patio Enclosures](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#services): Convert an existing concrete slab or patio into a screened outdoor room. Faster and more affordable than building from scratch. HOA-compliant designs for all local communities. Matched to your home's exterior trim and color. Most projects complete in 2–4 days.

- [Porch Repair & Re-Screening](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#services): Same-week service for torn screens, rotten wood, sagging frames, and leaky roof flashing. Honest repair-vs-replace assessment. Re-screening available in fiberglass, pet-resistant, solar, or no-see-um mesh.

## Cost Estimator

- [Screened Porch Cost Calculator](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#calculator): Interactive tool providing realistic project ranges based on current Upstate SC material and labor rates (updated May 2026). Cost ranges from approximately $8,000–$12,000 for a basic aluminum-framed patio enclosure to $25,000–$40,000+ for a full custom wood-framed porch with gable roof, ceiling fan, and EZ Breeze windows. Base rate: $65/sq ft for aluminum framing + standard screen + shed roof.

## FAQ

- [How much does a screened porch cost in Simpsonville SC in 2026?](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#faq): $8,000–$12,000 for basic patio enclosure; $25,000–$40,000+ for full custom porch. Greenville County average was $28,400 for a 240 sq ft project (2025 permit data).
- [Do screened porches require a permit in Greenville or Laurens County SC?](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#faq): Yes. Permit approval takes 7–14 business days. We handle all permit filings at no extra charge.
- [What screen type is best for properties near ponds or woods?](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#faq): No-See-Um screen (20×20 mesh). Standard fiberglass lets no-see-um gnats pass through. Upgrade adds $150–$300.
- [How long does it take to build a screened porch?](https://www.screenporchbuilder.com/#faq): 3–7 business days after permit approval (7–14 days). Patio enclosures often 2–3 days.
